codex.celestial.guide.1: Heaven portal: a glowstone frame lit with a Void Heart.
codex.celestial.guide.2: Grace comes from trials, puzzles, errands and bosses. Spend it on the Grace tab.
codex.celestial.guide.3: Radiance is spell mana. It regenerates twice as fast in Heaven.
codex.celestial.guide.4: V casts a spell, B cycles, G dashes, K opens the Codex.
codex.celestial.guide.5: A Sun Lens emits a beam; turn mirrors and prisms with a Tuning Fork.
codex.celestial.guide.6: Sky Forge: a core, 4 glowstone around and a beam from above. Diamond → aetherite.
codex.celestial.guide.7: The Imbuing Altar puts runes on gear.
codex.celestial.guide.8: Sky Beacons form a network: use one to pick a destination.
codex.celestial.guide.9: The Fading grows over time; each completed act reduces it.
codex.celestial.mob.angel: a sky village dweller. Trades and gives errands.
codex.celestial.mob.cherub: a tiny helper that gathers items.
codex.celestial.mob.cloud_jelly: bounces on touch and drops sky jelly.
codex.celestial.mob.cloud_whale: a cloud giant. Peaceful, travels in pods.
codex.celestial.mob.fallen_guardian: a Citadel guard who lost the light. Fears the Spear of Light.
codex.celestial.mob.fallen_seraph: lord of the Citadel, marked by the Faceless.
codex.celestial.mob.light_wisp: a guide that leads to the nearest shrine.
codex.celestial.mob.mimic: a chest with teeth. Found in ruins.
codex.celestial.mob.pegasus: a winged horse: white, golden or storm-born.
codex.celestial.mob.shadow: spawn of the Fading. Burns in sunlight, fears light, slips behind you.
codex.celestial.mob.sky_ray: a rideable ray that carries two.
codex.celestial.mob.storm_spirit: a child of storms, common on the Storm Peak.
codex.celestial.mob.winged_serpent: a sky predator that dives from above.
codex.celestial.place.abyss: the world beneath the clouds, almost without light. Without a flame in hand, fear grows.
codex.celestial.place.abyss_rift: a cracked island at the bottom of Heaven. Its black funnel leads down into the Abyss.
codex.celestial.place.airship_wreck: a galleon wreck full of loot.
codex.celestial.place.beam_temple: a beam puzzle: guide the light with mirrors.
codex.celestial.place.cloud_castle: a dungeon castle with traps and guards.
codex.celestial.place.flame_sanctuary: a shrine above the Nether lava. Its trial of fire guards a Flame Shard.
codex.celestial.place.meteor_crater: a starfall scar: a meteorite core and starquartz.
codex.celestial.place.observatory: the stargazers' tower. Light every star tile to open the vault.
codex.celestial.place.sky_lighthouse: a Sky Beacon: a node of the teleport network.
codex.celestial.place.sky_ruins: remains of ancient Heaven. Mimics hide here.
codex.celestial.place.sky_village: home of angels: trade and an errand board.
codex.celestial.place.telescope: a telescope shows how many stars have gone out.
codex.celestial.place.trial_tower: seven floors of trials that reward Grace.
codex.celestial.place.void_rift: a rift on the End's outskirts where Shadows seep through.
codex.celestial.saga.text.0: Act I "The Fading Light". The world's light is fading. Gather three shards: Flame (the Blazing Sanctuary in the Nether), Void (the Ender Dragon or a Void Rift) and Light (the Fallen Seraph in Heaven's Citadel), then return them to the Citadel altar.
codex.celestial.saga.text.1: Act I complete. The Fading has receded, but the Seraph bore the mark of the Faceless: a face without a face. Something waits beneath Heaven's clouds. The saga continues in the Abyss.
codex.celestial.title: Codex of the Heavens
fading.celestial.grow.1: The world's light dims a little…
fading.celestial.grow.2: Nights grow longer. Monsters grow fiercer.
fading.celestial.grow.3: Shadows stir in the dark. The Fading reaches its third stage.
fading.celestial.grow.4: Stars go out one by one. Shadows come in packs.
fading.celestial.grow.5: The world is almost lost to darkness. The final stage of the Fading.
fading.celestial.meteor_seen: A fiery streak crosses the sky — something fell nearby!
fading.celestial.weaken: The light returns! The Fading recedes to stage %s.
grace.celestial.second_wind: Second Wind saved you from death!

item.celestial.wanderer_journal.lore1: Right-click to read. Pages appear as the story unfolds
journal.celestial.finale:
The light has returned, though not all of it.

The Fading recedes and the stars burn again. Yet a chill rises from beneath Heaven's clouds: down there waits whoever left that mark on the Seraph.

§oEnd of Act I. The Saga of the Heavens continues...§r
journal.celestial.flame: The Flame is yours. It is warm but does not burn, as if it remembers the sky.
journal.celestial.gates:
Heaven! Islands float above the clouds and gravity is gentle here. Mind the edge: fall off and you will find yourself high above the Overworld.

The wisps will guide you to the shrines.
journal.celestial.intro:
Wanderer,

if you are reading this, the light of the heavens is fading. Nights grow longer, stars fall one by one and Shadows roam the dark.

Three shards held the light: Flame, Void and Light. They were scattered across three worlds. The stargazers in their observatories know more: look through a telescope.
journal.celestial.seraph:
The Seraph has fallen. His wings and halo are yours now, and so is the Light Shard.

But a mark is burned into his chest: a face without a face. The Seraph did not betray the sky. Something devoured him.
journal.celestial.task_altar:
§lThe last step§r

The Celestial Altar stands in the Citadel. Place all three shards upon it.
journal.celestial.task_flame:
§lThe first shard§r

The Flame Shard is guarded by the Blazing Sanctuary above the Nether lava sea: pass its trial of fire. It has also turned up in fortresses, bastions and blazes.
journal.celestial.task_gates:
§lThe Gates§r

Radiant Stone is forged from glowstone dust, Nether quartz and gold. Build a frame of it (like a Nether portal) and touch it with the Void Heart.
journal.celestial.task_seraph:
§lThe third shard§r

The Light Shard was stolen by the Fallen Seraph. He sleeps sealed in the Celestial Citadel. Prepare well: etherite armor, a starbow and plenty of manna.
journal.celestial.task_void:
§lThe second shard§r

The Void Heart beats inside the Ender Dragon. Defeat it and the Heart will fall at your feet. It is also found at the Void Rifts on the End's outskirts, where Shadows seep through.
journal.celestial.void: The Void Heart pulses in your hand. It opens what is closed to mortals.

puzzle.celestial.riddle.0: §6The runes read: §fI fall but never break. I fly but have no wings. What am I?
puzzle.celestial.riddle.1: §6The runes read: §fSofter than down, whiter than snow, it holds those who walk the sky.
puzzle.celestial.riddle.2: §6The runes read: §fWithout legs I walk, without hands I point, without eyes I know the night.
puzzle.celestial.riddle.3: §6The runes read: §fBorn in the darkness of the Nether, yet I carry light.
puzzle.celestial.riddle.4: §6The runes read: §fFood that falls from the sky.
puzzle.celestial.riddle.5: §6The runes read: §fI always look one way, wherever you go.
puzzle.celestial.riddle.6: §6The runes read: §fI am the voice of the deep that repeats after you.
puzzle.celestial.riddle.7: §6The runes read: §fFell from the sky, but not rain. Shines, but not fire.
puzzle.celestial.riddle.solved: §aThe riddle is solved - the runes glow calmly.

story.celestial.epilogue.1: §e✦ The shards merge into a pillar of light that pierces the clouds.
story.celestial.epilogue.2: §e✦ Stars light up above the Overworld again.
story.celestial.epilogue.3: §e✦ The angels step out and sing, but the stargazers frown: not all the light came back.
story.celestial.epilogue.4: §e✦ The Blessing of the heavens is upon you: +2 hearts, forever.
story.celestial.epilogue.5: §8✦ A whisper rises from beneath the clouds: "Light is only food..." The Saga of the Heavens continues.
